item.summary: fix(gateway): submit known image models without discovery delay (#123476) Use lifecycle-prepared model capability evidence during Gateway image admission so known image-capable models such as gpt-5.6-sol do not wait for full live provider discovery before chat.send acknowledgement. Preserve live discovery for incomplete catalogs and runtime-only models, while treating complete catalog negatives as authoritative.\n\nRelated: #122350
